integrity.independent_scientific_validation: Not performed; originality comparisons cannot exclude inaccessible equivalent specializations.
integrity.scientific_basis: Proofs of uniform-subspace reduction, geometric convolution, central limits, block-triangular spectrum and single-bridge phase transition are included; check.py provides exact-rational finite-instance replay.

scientific_limitations: Deterministic synchronous DeGroot dynamics with uniformly initialized topics; all internal networks are row stochastic, with positive diagonals.
Homogeneous Gaussian profile uses bridge strength fixed in (0,1); heterogeneous CLT requires strengths bounded away from zero and one.
One-bottleneck theorem considers a single exceptional bridge and all other bridges with one fixed strength.
No claim of novelty for classical geometric waiting-time identities, binomial CLT, pure-birth processes or generic nonnormal spectral facts.
No conclusion about arbitrary initial disagreements, non-chain interlayer networks or empirical opinion dynamics.
title: Depth-driven influence cutoff and a sharp bottleneck transition in multiplex DeGroot chains
